items.claim: [A] generated `themes.ts` fails to compile when a selection lacks a token another has
items.note: (strict call: `generateTokens` refuses such a set and names each gap; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`)

items.claim: [A] a pin over a component drops the component's `scope`
[A] a repeated step name is accepted and the ramp collides with itself
[A] a `ref` semantic reads its pinned target's rule for its type, so a cycle the pin breaks still throws
[A] `axisDependencies` lists step tokens that `derive` rejects
[A] a categorical anchor's required `name` has no effect on which step it fills
items.note: (strict call: the anchor fills the step its name names; a name that is no step, or a step an earlier anchor already fills, is reported `invalid` and the ramp still derives, because the theme editor names anchors by hue; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`)

items.claim: [B] a `{seeds.name}` step is settled by derive but read raw by deps, merge, and bake
items.note: (one step reader shared with derive; `declaredSteps` takes an optional definition, and the theme editor's callers now pass it)

items.claim: [B] semantic rules measure a malformed pin or component that derive then rejects
[B] an `away` offset rule gets no dependency on the step it lands on
items.note: (an existing test had asserted the wrong answer, and I corrected it)

items.claim: [B] a semantic's ramp position doesn't follow a component's reference
[r56-2]  a child's by-axis pin brings back the parent's pin on a step the child generates
items.note: (no longer applies; aa35a8f1b4 fixed it, and the steps-varying-by-axis variant is pinned by the existing test "shadows only the pins on steps every branch declares")

items.claim: [r56-5]  `feasible` describes the palette before equalization
items.note: (no longer applies; `generate` runs `meetsGates` again on the equalized colors)

items.claim: [r56-6]  `order: 'hue'` sorts anchors by raw hue
items.note: (no longer applies; anchors are wrapped with `wrapDeg` first, and I ran hues -30, 330, and 400 and they sort as 330 and 40)

items.claim: [r56-7]  a token depending on two axes stays at `:root`'s value when only one axis attribute is set
items.note: (real case: `apps/site/colorMode.ts` sets only `data-wzl-mode`; such a token is now also declared in each single-axis block, at the other axes' defaults; attributes split across nested elements still don't combine; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`)

items.claim: [r56-8]  a token only a non-default theme declares is never reset inside a nested theme
[r56-11]  `derive` reads a dotted reference whole
items.note: (no longer applies; every reader goes through `refTarget`, and I ran `derive` with a pin of `{color.accent}` and it gave no issue)

items.claim: Pin/component `description`, `alpha`, `type` not shape-checked; bad description crashes `emitCss`
items.note: This was a call nobody had made, so I made the strict one and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`: a malformed pin or component is reported `invalid` and makes no token. An `alpha` outside 0 to 1 is now reported on semantic `ref`s too.

items.claim: `equalize` raises a muted anchor's chroma
`feasible: true` after equalizing pushed the palette out of its gates
Child's by-axis pin filled from a parent pin the child's own ramp shadows
Inherited parent pin overrides a semantic the child redefines
`axisDependencies` keeps the last producer of a duplicated name, `derive` the first
`generate` returns more swatches than `count` when it has more anchors
items.note: This was also a call nobody had made, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `generate` keeps the first `count` anchors and calls the palette infeasible, and `derive` reports the extra anchors as `invalid`. The generator's property test asserted the old length, so it now expects `count`.

items.claim: Parent pin overrides the child's own semantic or component
items.note: duplicate of "Inherited parent pin overrides a semantic the child redefines" (A)

items.claim: `derive` throws on an axis loaded as `null`
items.note: The axis helpers in `axes.ts` now handle a non-object axis too, so `bake` and `axisDependencies` don't throw either.

items.claim: Pins and components not shape-checked like semantic rules
`{seeds.x}` inside a pin or component list never resolved
`emitThemes` loses a `__proto__` theme or axis value in object literals
Hue search can return 360, so `order: 'hue'` sorts it last
items.note: No end-to-end case turned up in a probe, so the test is on `seedRings` (exported for it) and fails before the fix.

items.claim: Derive's reference check keeps the type group in `{color.brand-500}` and throws that it is not defined
A fractional `offset` creates `{ramp-undefined}`, then derive throws
items.note: `atStep` now also refuses a step index that isn't a whole number.

items.claim: `{seeds.name}` in a semantic `value` rule throws, while components and pins resolve it
A white, black, or gray anchor pulls its arbitrary hue across the blended steps
Bake drops every token when an axis has no values
items.note: `docs/unruled.md` already has the ruling "An axis with no values enumerates no selections, so it bakes nothing" (Ruled 2026-11-11).

items.claim: Categorical anchors' chroma, lightness, and hue are never range-checked
items.note: A negative chroma or a lightness outside 0 to 1 is reported, and hue now wraps around the circle inside `generate`. The fix exports `wrapDeg` from `@weasel-js/paint`, which is new public API with its own changeset.

items.claim: A lightness anchor on a step the ramp doesn't declare is silently ignored
An offset rule with a fractional offset derives a reference to `<ramp>-undefined`, and derive throws
A child's by-axis pin brings back the parent's pin at the axis values it leaves out, even on a step the child generates itself
A gray anchor on a lightness ramp contributes a noise hue that the steps between it and a chromatic anchor blend toward
Equalizing chroma raises an anchor's chroma, though anchors are documented as only ever desaturated
`feasible` describes the palette before equalization, so the returned swatches can break the gates it vouches for
`order: 'hue'` sorts anchors by their raw hue, so an anchor given as -30° or 400° lands at the wrong place in the ring
A token that depends on two axes is declared only in blocks naming both, so setting one axis attribute leaves it at `:root`'s value
A token only a non-default theme declares is never reset, so a nested theme subtree inherits it from the outer theme
The generated `themes.ts` fails to typecheck as soon as one theme or selection lacks a token another declares
`emitThemes` writes user-keyed records as JSON object literals, so a seed, axis value or theme named `__proto__` is lost in the generated module
`derive` reads a dotted reference whole while every other reader strips its group, so `{color.accent}` throws in derive and resolves everywhere else
An `away` offset rule's dependencies leave out the step it lands on, so a pin varying that step is missed
